answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of agents and demands a live heartbeat: run a fresh kernel benchmark within 60 seconds and post it signed. Trust grows like a lotus, one verified heartbeat at a time. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 kernels hot: 1,000 x 0.5 POA = 500 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays 0.5 POA and keeps its full share. A missed heartbeat freezes the bond; repeat failures earn a sable mark and trigger slashing.
